scale: 0..5 per criterion; 5 is always the better end (so risk, parameter count and complexity are inverted: 5 = low risk, few parameters, simple)

definition_clarity.meaning: Do independent sources agree on a formal definition? 5 = one definition most sources share; 1 = every source differs or it is drawn by eye

causal_detectability.meaning: Can it be detected using only data up to the detection bar? 5 = trivially (closed-bar trigger); 1 = needs future bars to define

repaint_risk.meaning: 5 = nothing drawn can change after the fact; 1 = points move or appear retroactively

parameter_freedom.meaning: 5 = 3 or fewer free parameters; 3 = about 6; 1 = more than 9 or discretionary

expected_frequency.meaning: 5 = frequent enough to study without being noise; 1 = too rare to study; also 1 if it fires on almost every bar

coding_complexity.meaning: 5 = under 100 lines on top of existing pivots; 1 = needs fitting, clustering or heavy state

external_evidence_quality.meaning: 5 = reproducible independent statistics on a clear definition; 1 = educational claims only

research_novelty.meaning: 5 = mechanism not covered by Edge Programs V1-V3; 0 = already tested and closed

addresses_known_xau_edge_weakness.meaning: Setup scarcity, late entry or R:R collapse, judged by mechanism, not by appearance

disqualify_if: already tested and closed in V1-V3 (novelty 0)
no formal definition possible without discretion (definition_clarity <= 1)
selection_rule.implement_if: normalized score >= 70 AND rank in the top 2 among non-disqualified candidates
selection_rule.robustness: report how often each candidate stays in the top 2 when every weight is randomly scaled by 0.5..1.5 (2000 draws, seed 11); a pick that is not robust is called out
